categories.name: Skin
categories.blurb: The prep and the take-off. Makeup starts and ends here.

products.name: Velvet Matte Lipstick
products.tagline: A true matte that doesn't feel like one.
description: Eight hours of colour with none of the tightness. A cushioned matte base carries pigment in a thin, even film, so lips stay comfortable long after the coffee has gone cold.
Built to layer: press one coat for a stained wash, or build two for full, saturated opacity.

products.name: Glass Lip Oil
description: A weightless oil that reads like glass on camera and feels like nothing on the lips. Sheer colour with a treatment base that conditions as it wears.
Wear it alone for a fresh, everyday lip, or over the Velvet Matte to soften a hard edge.

products.name: Precision Lip Liner
products.tagline: A 1.5 mm tip that never needs sharpening.
description: Fine enough to draw a real edge, creamy enough not to drag. Sets to a soft, budge-proof finish that keeps colour where you put it.
Shades are matched to the Velvet Matte range, so pairing takes no thought.

products.name: The Nine Palette
description: Four mattes, three satins and two soft-focus shimmers, arranged so any three neighbouring pans make a finished look. No filler shades, no pan you'll never touch.
Milled fine enough to blend with a single brush, pigmented enough to hold a crease.

products.name: Feather Brow Pencil
description: An ultra-fine 1 mm tip with a waxy, dry-touch payoff that mimics individual hairs instead of blocking in shape. The spoolie end softens anything too deliberate.
Four shades that cover cool to warm without going orange.

products.name: Lift & Length Mascara
description: A tapered fibre brush catches the inner corners and lifts from the root, building length coat by coat without a single clump.
Holds a curl through a long day and comes off with warm water — no scrubbing, no lash loss.

products.name: Weightless Skin Tint SPF 30
products.tagline: Twenty shades. Your skin, evened out.
description: Sheer-to-medium coverage that sits in the skin rather than on it, with broad-spectrum SPF 30 built in. It photographs without flashback and never settles into texture.
Twenty shades across cool, neutral and warm undertones — matched properly, not approximately.

products.name: Cloud Cream Blush
products.tagline: Blends with a fingertip. Stays all day.
description: A cream-to-powder blush that melts into skin tint without lifting it, leaving a soft flush that looks like circulation rather than product.
Works on bare skin too — press it on, tap the edges out, done.

products.name: Soft Focus Setting Powder
description: Finely milled to blur texture and hold makeup in place without the dry, powdery cast that shows up under flash.
Three tones so it disappears on fair, medium and deep skin alike.

products.name: Sunlit Cream Bronzer
description: A true neutral-warm bronzer with no orange pull, formulated to sit softly along the places light actually hits.
Cream texture means it moves with the face — no harsh edges to blend out.

products.name: Prep Hydrating Primer
products.tagline: The step that makes everything else work.
description: A hydrating gel primer that gives makeup something to hold onto. Skin drinks it in; product goes on smoother and stays put hours longer.
No silicone slip, no pilling under skin tint.

products.name: Melt Cleansing Balm
products.tagline: Takes off everything, including the mascara.
description: A solid balm that turns to oil on contact and rinses to milk with water. Dissolves long-wear makeup and SPF in one pass, without stripping the skin underneath.
Safe around the eyes, and gentle enough for every night.
